label: Extra confessions
blurb: Before the morning Mass, after the evening one, on the feast days. A light on.

label: Home and hospital visits
blurb: The sick, the shut-in, the family that stopped coming. Your car knows the way to the hospital.

label: Personal prayer and adoration
blurb: The holy hour you promised the bishop you would keep. The only thing on the list that no one will ask about.

label: Study
blurb: The books from seminary, the journal you still subscribe to, the language you are losing.

label: Time with brother priests
blurb: Dinner on the day off, the deanery meeting you stay after, the phone call to the classmate across town.

label: Administrative catch-up
blurb: The sacramental registers, the letters, the forms the chancery wants by Friday.

label: Civic and community presence
blurb: The Rotary lunch, the school board, the interfaith breakfast, the police chief who wants a blessing.

label: Correspondence and writing
blurb: Letters answered, the bulletin column, the article someone asked for.

label: Sustaining the groups
blurb: The youth group needs a chaperone, the guild needs a blessing, the Vincentians need someone to sign.
